text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The WBC ended in a narrow defeat. However, 
the Three Goddesses commended them, noting 
that Trainer and Umamusume were working in 
perfect unison.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Bitter Glasse, who had been 
unable to win since autumn, failed to 
deliver a satisfying performance in the 
WBC as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Bitter Glasse motivated for next 
year, Trainer Kashimoto secretly 
strengthens her own resolve, convinced 
that she herself must work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek also fell 
short of the "graded race victory within 
the year" goal they had set during the 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While it was meant to be a goal to keep 
her spirits up, it only caused her 
frustration to smolder even more over her 
stubbornly unblooming potential.
